## Stymphalian Bird (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
 N Medium magical beast  

**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +6  

  

**Defense**

 **AC** 16, touch 12, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +4 natural)  

**hp** 26 (4d10+4)  

**Fort** +5, **Ref** +6, **Will** +2  

  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft., fly 70 ft. (average)  

**Melee** 2 claws +6 (1d6+2, 19-20), bite +6 (1d8+2, 19-20)  

**Ranged** 4 feathers +7 (1d4+2, 19-20)  

**Special Attacks** feathers  

  

**Tactics**

 Stymphalian birds are particularly fond of the flesh of humans and elves, and always attack them on sight.  
 A stymphalian bird attacks from the air by releasing a volley of bronze feathers at its opponents. It then swoops down and attacks with its beak and wings, flying out of range before its opponents can react. On the ground, a stymphalian bird slashes with its wings and stabs with its beak.  

  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 14, **Dex** 14, **Con** 12, **Int** 6, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 2  

**Base Atk** +4; **CMB** +6; **CMD** 18  

**Feats** Flyby Attack, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Critical (claw), Improved Critical (feather), Weapon Focus (feathers)  

**Skills** Fly +7, Perception +6  

  

**Special Abilities**

 **Feathers (Ex)** A stymphalian bird can loose a volley of four feathers as a standard action when flying (make an attack roll for each feather). This attack has a range of 60 feet with no range increment. All targets must be within 30 feet of each other. The creature can launch only twelve feathers (3 volleys) in a single day. The stymphalian bird may use this ability in conjunction with its Flyby Attack feat.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** temperate forests and hills  

**Organization** solitary or flock (2-5)  

**Treasure** none
